# fw remove

> Reference of the fw remove command: Remove a dependency from the project. Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/remove/

Remove a dependency from the project

## Usage

```bash
fw remove <pkg>
```

## Aliases

`fw rm` runs `fw remove`. `fw uninstall` runs `fw remove`.

## Global options

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
